decisions.reason: The DPA management tool has its own page, draws positive agency feedback and fits the firm's announced compliance and agency focus, so management stays committed to it.
The management platform is featured on the home page, required heavy in-house development and is central to the agency platform strategy, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core offer, still has a page of its own and costs little to sustain on the owned infrastructure.

Extended PHP security support is only mentioned on the website and depends on legacy PHP versions that customers will phase out, but it fits the security promise and its weak visibility can still be blamed on its recent launch.
